notes: Added required stories for MAINT-CONSENT feature covering schema, logic, API integration, and testing.

stories.title: Consent Schema and Contract Corrections
stories.description: Define and fix inconsistencies in two-tier consent schema including Tier 1 vs Tier 2 flags, consent timestamps, and de-identification markers to ensure alignment across ConsentService and LeadService.

stories.title: Fix Core Two-Tier Consent Logic and Edge Cases
stories.description: Resolve defects in ConsentService including incorrect tier escalation, failure paths when consent is partially granted, and improper handling of de-identified vs identifiable data transitions.

stories.title: Consent Flow API and Tool Router Integration Fixes
stories.description: Ensure consent state is correctly propagated through tool_router and exposed consistently to downstream services (lead capture, unknown question handling) including fixing missing or stale consent state in requests.

stories.title: Consent Framework Test Suite and Edge Case Validation
stories.description: Implement unit and integration tests covering tier transitions, rejection paths, duplicate consent attempts, and de-identification compliance to prevent regression.

per_feature.mitigation: Focus fixes strictly within existing consent service and validation layers without expanding scope.
